answer: To sell an inherited car, bring the death certificate and the court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate (letters testamentary or letters of administration); if there are several heirs, the executor signs. For a lost North Carolina title, you can request a duplicate by mail or at any North Carolina motor vehicle office with the registration and a photo ID; it takes 4 to 6 weeks, and while you can get an offer and book an appointment in the meantime, the purchase can't be completed until it arrives. The help center doesn't explain how the remaining loan affects the sale, or whether the duplicate process differs for an inherited car with a loan, so please contact a store for those details.
